material: Bi2Te3 with substitutional 3d/4d transition-metal dopants on Bi sites
source: R. Mozumder, J. Wasmer, D. Antognini Silva, S. Bluegel, P. Ruessmann, High-throughput magnetic co-doping and design of exchange interactions in topological insulators, Materials Cloud Archive 2024 (doi:10.24435/materialscloud:b7-6k), arXiv:2407.04413; KKR impurity embedding (JuKKR/aiida-kkr), spin-orbit coupling included, exchange from infinitesimal rotations in impurity-dimer calculations

host_hexagonal_A.note: Bi1 at z = 0.4 and Bi2 at z = 0.6 of the rhombohedral cell; the two Bi layers of a quintuple layer are related by inversion

columns.i_shell: index of the impurity-dimer configuration (neighbour shell), 0-16
columns.Rx, Ry, Rz: one connecting vector of the shell (Angstrom), as extracted by the authors
columns.ilayer2: Bi layer of impurity 2 (impurity 1 always substitutes Bi1): 3 = Bi1 sublattice, 4 = Bi2 sublattice
columns.Zimp1, Zimp2: atomic numbers of impurity 1 and impurity 2 (Zimp1 <= Zimp2)
columns.num_neighbors: number of equivalent Bi sites in this shell
columns.m1, m2: spin moments (muB) of impurity 1 and impurity 2 read from the dimer calculation
columns.m01, m02: spin moments (muB) of impurity 1 and impurity 2 as isolated single impurities
columns.J: isotropic exchange constant J_ij (meV) of the dimer
columns.J_data_uuid: AiiDA uuid of the JijData node (provenance)

archive.authors_hamiltonian: H = -(1/2) sum_{i,j} J_ij S_i . S_j with S_i = m_i/|m_i| the unit vector along the moment of impurity i (paper Eq. 2)
archive.authors_note: single impurities with spin moment below 1e-3 muB are treated as non-magnetic (paper, Sec. III D)

pair.returns: every archived row of that dopant pair (either order) within the window, verbatim; calculations that are not in the archive are simply absent

monte_carlo.model: classical unit-vector spins on randomly chosen Bi sites (both Bi layers), H = -sum_{i<j} J_ij e_i.e_j with exchange_meV[pair][k] applied to every pair of spins at the distance of archive shell k (k = 0-16) and nothing beyond; keys are species pairs ordered by atomic number
monte_carlo.spins: concentration of each spin-carrying species as a fraction of all Bi sites (one or two species, 0.005-0.11 each, at most 0.11 in total); non-magnetic dopants need not be listed
monte_carlo.supercell: periodic orthorhombic cell of (7 size) x (4 size) x (size) units of (a, sqrt(3) a, c), 336 size^3 Bi sites; each species gets round(concentration x sites) spins
monte_carlo.samples: independent random dopant placements; seed selects a different set of placements
monte_carlo.sweeps: per temperature 1000 equilibration + 3000 measurement sweeps (heat bath + 2 over-relaxation); temperatures are run from high to low, each continuing from the previous configuration
monte_carlo.note: runs take up to a few minutes; poll the job
